Job Title

Product Software Security Engineer

Are you a software engineer who believes security belongs in software from the start? As a Product Security Engineer, you'll help teams build secure, resilient, and maintainable products by combining software engineering, software craftsmanship, and product security expertise.

You'll work with Product Security Architects, development teams, and the Product Security Office to turn security requirements, guidance, and assessment findings into practical solutions. Review code to find vulnerabilities, improve design, and raise code quality.

Apply software craftsmanship practices such as design patterns, code refactoring, legacy modernization, and TDD.

Stay current with engineering and cybersecurity trends and bring improvements to teams.

You are currently living in The Netherlands.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
At least 5 years of experience in software development and software product security and one or more of the following: application security, secure software development, DevSecOps, or equivalent.

Software Engineering

Software architecture & design patterns, SDLC
Clean code, code refactoring, legacy code modernization, code quality, and code reviews, TDD, BDD, CI/CD, test automation, and continuous improvement
Product software security, DevSecOps, SSDLC, vulnerability management, secure coding, threat modeling, application security, and security architecture
Security monitoring, logging, and operational resilience

Job Description:
Hi! I’m Ivan 👋 Director of Platform & Infrastructure here at WeTravel. I joined WeTravel to help build a secure, reliable, and scalable IT environment as we grow. Our team’s mission is to empower every WeTravel employee with the tools and support they need to work efficiently, securely, and without friction — no matter where they are in the world.

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we’re on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we’re building the engine to make more of that possible.

What’s The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on Developer Experience, you'll help make it fast and easy for WeTravel engineers to build, test, deploy, and operate software.

You'll work on the internal platform and tooling used by our product engineering teams: CI/CD, developer environments, service tooling, deployment workflows, observability, and self-service infrastructure. Our goal is to remove unnecessary complexity from everyday development and provide paved roads that let engineers ship confidently without needing to understand every detail of the underlying infrastructure.

You'll be part of the Platform team, so this isn't a tooling-only role. You'll also contribute to our AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, reliability, and operational improvements. But your primary customers are our engineers, and your primary focus will be making their development experience better.

What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Developer Experience & Internal Tooling: Build and improve the tools and workflows engineers use every day. Identify friction in the development lifecycle and turn it into practical tooling, automation, and platform improvements.
CI/CD & Developer Environments: Make it fast and reliable to build, test, and deploy software. Improve CI/CD pipelines, local development environments, test environments, and the path from writing code to running it in production.
Self-Service & Paved Roads: Build reusable workflows, service templates, and platform capabilities that allow product teams to solve common problems without depending on the Platform team. Reduce cognitive load while keeping the underlying systems flexible.
Reliability & Observability: Help engineers understand and operate their services in production. Improve observability, incident response, SLIs/SLOs, and the tooling that makes production issues easier to detect, debug, and resolve.
Infrastructure & Cloud: Contribute to the AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform foundations behind our platform. Improve scalability, security, cost efficiency, and multi-region readiness while keeping infrastructure easy for product engineers to consume.

How We Work

We’re focused on the impact. We don’t subscribe to any one framework or execution ideology, and we adapt based on what’s impactful.
We’re using the latest hardware and constantly on the look out for better tools & ways to work
Stack: We’re using React/ReactNative/TypeScript + Ruby on Rails, Go and Python Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Snowflake and we’re working with the major LLM providers.

8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in developer tooling, internal platforms, infrastructure, or related platform engineering.
2+ years of hands-on experience in a Developer Experience (DevEx) team, building internal tooling, platforms, and workflows for software engineers.

Excellent communication skills and a pragmatic, hands-on mindset with a bias toward action.

Experience with security and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 or PCI-DSS.

Why join us?

Direct impact on a product used by thousands of travel businesses worldwide.
Remote-friendly culture with teams across Amsterdam, Baku, and the US.

Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success.
Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation.

"Ontwerpt interoperabiliteitslagen die modellen, data en systemen betrouwbaar met elkaar laten praten."

Bij Haskoning kom je te werken bij een onafhankelijk adviesbureau dat ingenieurs-, ontwerp- en adviesdiensten combineert met software en technologie. Onze missie, “Enhancing Society Together" drijft ons om een positieve impact op de wereld te creëren.

DevOps Engineer

Ben jij een DevOps Engineer die graag leert en met doorzetten en creativiteit problemen oplost ? Iemand die naast deze oplossingsgerichte instelling ook communicatief vaardig genoeg is om klantcontact te hebben en binnen het team te presenteren? Dan zijn we zeker naar jou op zoek!

Cyso ontwerpt, bouwt, beheert en beveiligt 24×7 webapplicatie platformen in onze enterprise cloud en op ons cloud native Cyso Cloud platform. We hebben onze eigen infrastructuur verdeeld over 3 datacenters in Amsterdam en Frankfurt. We geloven in cloud neutrale oplossingen en maken gebruik van cloud tooling en de SRE mindset – óók voor meer traditionele setups. We zijn een team van nieuwsgierige hosting experts, beheren ons eigen netwerk en meer dan 10 miljoen domeinnamen zijn afhankelijk van onze beschikbaarheid.

Als DevOps Engineer in het Delivery-team werk je met collega’s om de juiste oplossing voor de klant te bieden en is er een goede wisselwerking tussen verkoop en oplevering.

Jij ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en optimaliseert nieuwe en bestaande platformen en infrastructuren. Daarnaast werk je aan het ontwerpen en optimaliseren van bestaande en nieuwe producten en diensten. Je zet omgevingen op om complexe en schaalbare (internet) applicaties te hosten. Waarborging van de kwaliteit is onderdeel van jouw werkdomein. Ook houd je je bezig met het automatiseren van handmatige processen, zoals het bouwen van services, deployen van software of het realiseren van een infrastructuur.

Samen met het team werk je aan kortlopende opdrachten tot langlopende trajecten voor diverse MKB en grootzakelijke klanten. Doordat je vanaf het begin bij een traject betrokken wordt kan er tijdig geschakeld worden. Je spreekt de klant vaak al voordat je iets gaat doen. Door deze afwisseling kun je alle kanten van jezelf laten zien en het beste uit jezelf halen.

Bij Cyso is er een mix van snel schakelen en gefocust aan de slag kunnen. Of er nu vanuit kantoor of huis gewerkt wordt, collega’s zijn altijd goed bereikbaar via mail en Slack. Het team is bereikbaar en maakt tijd om te zorgen dat iedereen succesvol aan de slag kan. Je krijgt alle ruimte om te doen wat goed is. Je krijgt het vertrouwen van collega’s dat je goed werk levert en wordt gesteund door het team.

Job Description:
About This Position

Help make our naval vessels invisible to the enemy with your software? Do you want to make a real impact by helping the Royal Netherlands Navy prepare for the future? Join TNO in The Hague as a Software Engineer!

Within the Autonomous Systems & Decision Support division, TNO develops technologies for autonomous systems, sensors, and decision support with direct relevance to Defence. The Integrated Mission Management department translates this expertise into practical software solutions for complex operational environments, including those on board naval vessels.

In this role, you will contribute to, among other things, maritime signature management systems software that helps predict and influence the visibility and vulnerability of ships. By doing so, you support the Royal Netherlands Navy in remaining effective, safe, and deployable under future operational conditions.

What will be your role?

As a Software Engineer, you will work on one or more projects within the department. In any case, you will become part of the highly motivated development team focused on signature management. Within this team, you will collaborate with scientific staff on a maritime signature management system that helps predict and influence the visibility of ships and their vulnerability to threats.

While the scientific staff focuses on the models and their underlying scientific principles, you will ensure that this knowledge is translated into robust, maintainable, and testable software for operational use aboard current and future naval vessels. You will develop a solid understanding of the key concepts behind the models and be able to connect them to the operational needs of the customer.

The team follows a SAFe/Scrum-based way of working. Within this environment, you will make a tangible contribution to a shared mission making signature management capabilities available to the Royal Netherlands Navy fleet.

What we expect from you

We are looking for a Software Engineer who is energized by building reliable software for complex, technically challenging applications. You enjoy collaborating with scientific staff and helping to transform their models and prototypes into robust, maintainable, and testable software suitable for operational use. Your strength lies in professionalizing software, safeguarding quality, and ensuring that research results can be applied reliably in practice.

We are looking for candidates with the following background and qualities

A degree or demonstrable background in Software Engineering. 
The ability to work independently, take ownership, and perform effectively as part of a team. 
A results-oriented and customer-focused mindset, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary environment. 
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions in a clear and understandable way. 

We are looking for people with knowledge of

Python and/or C++; experience with Java is a plus. 
Software development for Linux-based systems, specifically Debian and Red Hat. 
Software quality, testability, maintainability, and software testing techniques. 
Software parallelization. 

Experience with the following is considered a plus

GitLab CI/CD pipelines. 
Docker and Kubernetes. 

Requirements

You are available for at least 32 hours per week. 
You are fluent in English; Dutch is a plus. 
You are willing to work on-site at TNO in The Hague at least three days per week. 
Your commandment of the English (and preferably also the Dutch) language both verbally and in writing is excellent (C1 Level). 

What you'll get in return

Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between € 3,500,- and € 5,000,- (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself.

TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect

An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. 
The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 
33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). 
An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. 
We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. 
Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly. 
Flexible working hours, the possibility to work parttime (32 or 36 hours) and the possibility of working from home. 
A good pension scheme. 

Benefits

Read more about tailoring your benefits package.

TNO as an employer

Our people are at the heart of TNO. Their curiosity, expertise and entrepreneurial mindset make it possible to deliver high-impact research and innovations that contribute to society’s sustainable wellbeing and prosperity. That is why we invest in an inspiring and inclusive working environment where colleagues can excel, have autonomy and continue to grow.

Your talent and ambition have every opportunity to flourish at TNO. You work with experts (both within and beyond TNO), have access to advanced technology and the freedom to explore, experiment and innovate. Our strength lies in independence, reliability and collaboration. We find each other in wonder and ingenuity. We are driven to push boundaries. By working with businesses and government, and by connecting different perspectives, we strengthen our innovative capability and create responsible, meaningful results.

At TNO, we believe this is our time to help society, government and business move forward faster. Together with driven colleagues, you turn knowledge into concrete innovations or ventures that truly make a difference by combining the power of science and entrepreneurship. And in doing so, you make your mark on our time.

The selection process

Please apply before the 2nd of September, 2026. The selection process comprises two interview rounds. The preliminary interview takes place on the 17th or 21st of September, 2026. In a final meeting we will discuss the terms of employment and your tailored benefits package. We aim to finalize the entire process within four weeks.

The selection process may include an online assessment and a reference check.

A certificate of Conduct (VOG) is required before starting a new job at TNO.

As you will be working for clients in the domain of defence and security, a Certificate of No Objection issued by AIVD (the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will have to undergo a security screening. Read more about security screening.

Job Description:
As a Dev Engineer in our Core Banking environment, you will help shape the backbone of the bank. You will work on systems that process millions of daily transactions and form the foundation of payments, savings and loans. This role gives you the opportunity to work on complex challenges with direct impact across the entire organisation. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, improving stability and contributing to a reliable 24/7 banking experience, this role is for you.

The team

You will join the Core Bank NL department, home to our Account Engine (AE). This system processes transaction flows, maintains customer balances and supports interest calculations. Many ING services depend on this landscape, including online banking, mobile, cards and payments.

The Profile platform, our AE, is central to your work. The team maintains its stability, ensures compliance and drives improvements in performance and scalability. You will work in a highly collaborative environment where ideas are encouraged and engineers have a strong voice in shaping the technical roadmap. We value ownership, continuous learning and creating an environment where people feel supported and included.

Roles And Responsibilities

Supporting continuous delivery practices and secure deployment processes
Maintaining connections with consuming IT systems
Contributing to documentation and knowledge sharing
Collaborating with teams across the architectural landscape

How To Succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.

To Succeed In This Role, You Bring

Job Description:
Software Engineer at ActivityInfo
Location: Hybrid / The Hague (at least three days a week)
Type: Full-time

Help us develop the leading information management platform for social sector organizations worldwide.

Our small but growing team builds ActivityInfo, a web-based information management platform supporting humanitarian relief and development assistance operations. Our platform is used in over 70+ countries by customers such as UNICEF and other UN agencies.

About the Role
We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join our growing team. This full-stack development position requires at least three years of professional experience in Java or similar object-oriented languages, with a focus on database systems and data processing.
You will be a key player in developing and enhancing our platform, ensuring it continues to meet the critical information management needs of humanitarian and development assistance operations globally. This role offers the opportunity to work on impactful projects within a supportive environment, complemented by a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.
Our small, diverse, and international team prioritizes a healthy work-life balance, focusing on consistent, weekly improvements rather than high-pressure deadlines. We foster a welcoming and supportive environment for all backgrounds and identities.

Who We Are Looking For (For This Role)
We're seeking a highly independent and proactive individual who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. If you love diving into new challenges and continuously enhancing how things get done, you might be our next team member.
You'll enjoy the freedom and direct impact that comes with working in a smaller team within a scale-up company. This role is perfect for someone who's not just comfortable with uncertainty, but genuinely excited by the opportunity to learn and grow across diverse systems and technologies throughout the entire tech stack.

We're looking for someone who recognizes their strength in:

Autonomy & Initiative: You're a self-starter who takes ownership of your work, identifying problems and opportunities without constant oversight.
Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Your passion for learning new technologies and systems is evident, and you're adept at navigating and contributing across a broad tech stack.
Comfort with Ambiguity: You remain effective and focused even when faced with evolving requirements or less-defined paths. You see change as an opportunity, not a roadblock.
Team & Company Improvement: You're not just about your tasks; you actively look for ways to improve team processes, internal tools, and overall company efficiency. You're keen to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

We value individuals who are motivated to learn and adapt to a diverse range of technologies, including browser-based databases, JavaScript workers, GIS, and data visualization. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently on complex systems, can efficiently navigate large codebases, and has a strong understanding of design patterns.

Your Responsibilities
In this role, you will primarily work independently, maintaining regular communication with the engineering director. You will also be part of a collaborative team where mutual support is readily available. Your work will involve both front-end and back-end projects, addressing important and often complex challenges for our users. Your work will focus on new feature developments and improvements, and also a shared responsibility in maintaining the service with e.g. bug fixes.

In your role, you would contribute to projects such as:
Offline Synchronization: Enhancing conflict resolution during synchronization with our offline web client to ensure robust data flow.
Data Analysis Pipelines: Developing automated analysis pipelines for user datasets to provide valuable insights.
System Performance: Optimizing the performance of our system, especially when handling large datasets.
Accessibility: Ensuring that key application tasks are accessible to visually impaired users.
You will work with a range of technologies that underpin our platform, including Java, React, Sass, Google Web Toolkit (GWT), browser APIs like IndexedDB, and Google Cloud services such as App Engine and Cloud Datastore.

Essential Qualifications
Education in computer science, engineering, or software development. We are open to candidates with equivalent real-world experience, including those from non-traditional programs or alternative career paths in software development.
A minimum of 3 years of professional experience working with object-oriented programming languages such as Java.
Proficiency in English, as it is the primary language used for all our team communication.

Nice to haves
While not strictly required, these qualifications are beneficial:
Background or experience in database systems and data processing.
Experience using Google Cloud Platform and its services.
Front-end software development experience with any framework or technology.
UI/UX design experience.
Experience working in an Agile development environment.
Experience mentoring colleagues.

What We Offer
The compensation package/benefits of the role:

A gross salary of €4000 - €5500 per month (before taxes, and including 8% vakantiegeld paid monthly), depending on experience;
Contribution to a pension plan
25 days vacation per year.
Hybrid working with flexible hours / location. We would prefer to find someone who can join us physically in our office in the Hague, but will consider remote candidates with the right experience.
A public transport card for employees in the Netherlands for work-residence travel.
Time and budget for professional development.
An initial annual contract, with the intent to transition to a permanent arrangement upon successful performance and mutual fit.

Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a CSV Validation Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a senior, hands-on validation role supporting complex technology platforms used in pharmaceutical and other GxP-regulated environments.

You will lead risk-based computerized system validation across cloud applications, edge devices, scientific instruments, APIs, databases, and enterprise integrations.

Your work will help ensure regulated systems are fit for intended use, secure, reliable, and supported by complete, inspection-ready evidence.

You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, suppliers, and customers across the full system lifecycle.

The role combines regulatory expertise with technical investigation, requiring you to understand architectures, data flows, integrations, and system behavior.

You will also help mature validation practices by introducing practical structure, improving traceability, and leveraging modern engineering evidence.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a growing environment where validation is treated as a critical engineering discipline rather than a documentation exercise.

Accountabilities

Develop and execute risk-based validation strategies for new systems, product features, integrations, infrastructure changes, releases, and customer implementations, defining appropriate scope according to intended use, system complexity, data-integrity risks, and regulatory requirements.
Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive CSV deliverables, including validation plans, requirements, functional and configuration specifications, risk assessments, test protocols, IQ/OQ/PQ documentation where applicable, traceability matrices, deviation records, and validation summary reports.
Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear, objective, testable acceptance criteria and ensure requirements, risks, tests, defects, and evidence remain fully traceable.
Validate complex technology ecosystems spanning browser applications, cloud services, APIs, databases, edge devices, scientific instruments, and integrations with LIMS, MES, ELN, QMS, and other regulated systems.
Assess and test data flows, transformations, mappings, unit conversions, synchronization, recovery behavior, and failure scenarios to ensure data is not lost, duplicated, corrupted, or incorrectly attributed.
Evaluate systems against FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, PIC/S GMP, GAMP 5, ALCOA+ data-integrity principles, and other applicable regulatory expectations.
Validate controls covering electronic records and signatures, audit trails, identity and access management, security, timestamps, retention, archival, backup, recovery, availability, and data migration.
Perform validation impact assessments for software releases, configuration changes, infrastructure updates, bug fixes, security events, deviations, CAPAs, and integration changes, determining appropriate regression and validation scope.
Maintain systems in a validated state by supporting periodic reviews, controlled retirement, migration, archival, decommissioning, and resolution of open validation discrepancies.
Partner with Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, suppliers, and customer teams to review technical documentation and engineering evidence, avoid unnecessary testing duplication, and ensure GxP risks remain appropriately covered.
Prepare validation packages for Quality review, customer audits, supplier assessments, and regulatory inspections, clearly explaining validation strategies, risk decisions, controls, and test evidence.
Investigate unexpected results and discrepancies, distinguish meaningful product risks from low-value documentation issues, and support corrective and preventive actions.
Help establish consistent validation templates, processes, and practices within a growing organization while remaining practical, delivery-focused, and aligned with modern Computer Software Assurance principles.

Requirements

10+ years of computerized system validation experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, or another GxP-regulated environment, with proven ownership of end-to-end CSV activities.
Strong practical knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, PIC/S GMP, GAMP 5, and ALCOA+ data-integrity principles.
Demonstrated experience applying risk-based validation and Computer Software Assurance approaches to complex systems.
Hands-on experience developing user requirements, risk assessments, validation plans, protocols, traceability matrices, deviations, summary reports, and IQ/OQ/PQ documentation where applicable.
Experience validating configurable software, SaaS applications, cloud platforms, laboratory systems, manufacturing systems, or integrated technology environments.
Strong understanding of electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access controls, security, backup and recovery, retention, archival, and data migration.
Ability to understand and review technical documentation, system architectures, data flows, API specifications, engineering test evidence, and software change impacts.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and understand how complex technical systems behave.
Excellent technical writing and documentation skills, with a focus on producing clear, defensible, objective, and inspection-ready evidence.
Ability to manage multiple validation workstreams independently, prioritize competing deliverables, and operate effectively with limited supervision.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Quality, Operations, suppliers, and customer stakeholders in a remote environment.
Experience with cloud software, hardware, edge computing, IoT devices, and scientific instruments is strongly preferred.
Experience validating LIMS, MES, ELN, QMS, or similar enterprise integrations is an advantage.
Familiarity with REST APIs, relational databases, SQL, MQTT, asynchronous messaging, data transformations, field mappings, unit conversions, and multi-vendor data formats is beneficial.
Experience working within Agile software development environments and leveraging automated engineering tests as validation evidence is a plus.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure qualification, supplier assessments, customer-specific deployments, deviation management, CAPA, change control, document control, and periodic review processes is desirable.
Exposure to Japanese PMDA expectations or other Asia-Pacific regulatory authorities, as well as customer audits or regulatory inspections, would be an advantage.

Benefits

Senior-level opportunity with significant ownership across computerized system validation and regulated technology platforms.
Hands-on exposure to complex cloud, edge, laboratory, manufacturing, API, and scientific-instrument environments.
Opportunity to influence and strengthen validation processes within a growing organization.
Collaboration with cross-functional technical, product, quality, and customer-facing teams.
Remote-friendly working environment with autonomy and responsibility.
Opportunity to apply modern risk-based validation and Computer Software Assurance practices.
Professional growth through exposure to evolving technologies, regulatory requirements, and complex GxP use cases.
The opportunity to contribute directly to the reliability, compliance, and audit readiness of mission-critical systems.
